name: node-raw-releaseless
description: node-raw wired to a locally-built posthog-cli, for developing the release-decoupling (releaseless) error-tracking flow before it ships.

scripts.start: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm process && pnpm run:app
scripts.start:bound: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm process:bound && pnpm run:app
